mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 5.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in real GDP growth and housing starts indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive equity returns as corporate profits rise; the interaction effect is stronger than either series alone.
failure_condition: The interaction term between GDPC1 and HOUST has a negative or insignificant coefficient in a regression of 60-day SPX returns, or the joint signal fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%), the S&P 500 tends to rise over the next 20 days as central banks maintain accommodative policies, but the signal reverses during high inflation.
failure_condition: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the signal direction flips to negative in high inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 100k signals strong labor market health, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in industrial production above 1.5% annualized growth indicates robust manufacturing activity, which typically precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth is above 1.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation rises above 2.5% while the federal funds rate remains below 1.0%, the market anticipates delayed rate cuts, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days due to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer spending regimes (RSAFS growth above 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 tends to rise over the next 20 days, but the signal weakens during economic slowdowns.
regime_hint: strong consumer spending regime (RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly)
failure_condition: In strong consumer spending regimes (RSAFS growth > 0.5%), SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
